name: Porongurup

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon and Sémillon fully without cooking off their freshness.
Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Clay holds water well but drains poorly. It stays cool, which slows ripening and keeps acidity up.
soil.top: The topsoil stores water through dry spells, but stays wet and cold after rain, which slows ripening and can swell the grapes. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
